blurb: Blaine Harbor offers 629 boat slips for commercial and pleasure boats, protected by a heavy rock breakwater. Amenities include visitor moorage, free parking, public boat launch, showers, restrooms, laundry, dinghy racks, dock boxes, potable water, and WIFI for purchase. The harbor is a 5-star Certified Clean Marina with waterfront trails leading into historic downtown Blaine.
